# Command-line reference

Every `muckrake` command with its arguments and options, as printed by `--help`.

```text
Usage: muckrake [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Muckrake: A minimal FtM data processing framework.

Options:
  -v, --verbose  Increase logging verbosity. Repeat for debug output.
  --help         Show this message and exit.

List all available datasets:
  list  List all available datasets.

Crawl and extract:
  crawl  Crawl one or all datasets.

Named-entity recognition:
  ner-extract  Extract named entities from statement text fields.
  ner-review   Review pending NER extraction candidates.
  ner-export   Save all NER candidates and review decisions to a JSON lines file (.gz to
               compress).
  ner-import   Add NER candidates from an export; candidates already present are kept as
               they are.

Deduplicate:
  xref            Generate deduplication candidates.
  xref-prune      Remove dedupe candidates from the resolver.
  dedupe          Interactively judge candidates.
  dedupe-manual   Manually merge entities as duplicates.
  dedupe-explode  Undo deduplication by exploding a merged cluster.
  dedupe-edges    Deduplicate Representation edges across datasets in resolver.

Build releases:
  release-build    Build an immutable release artifact from dataset runs.
  release-list     List recent releases and their statuses.
  release-publish  Publish a built release into the read-only serving database.

Load to database:
  load    Load statements into the database.
  export  Export entities to FtM JSON.

Inspect and edit entities:
  add     Add or update one FtM entity in the working database.
  get     Get one FtM entity by canonical ID from the working database.
  search  Search FtM entities in the working database.
  update  Update one FtM entity in the working database by ID.
```

## `muckrake list`

```text
Usage: muckrake list [OPTIONS]

  List all available datasets.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `muckrake crawl`

```text
Usage: muckrake crawl [OPTIONS] [DATASET_NAME]

  Crawl one or all datasets.

  DATASET_NAME should be the dataset name from config.yml (e.g., hello). If not
  provided, crawls all datasets.

Options:
  -o, --output PATH  Override output path
  -c, --clear        Clear dataset data before crawling
  --retry-failed     Carry over the units that succeeded in the dataset's latest crawl
                     and re-run the rest (failed units, and any never reached if that
                     crawl crashed)
  --help             Show this message and exit.
```

## `muckrake ner-extract`

```text
Usage: muckrake ner-extract [OPTIONS] [DATASET_NAME]

  Extract named entities from statement text fields.

Options:
  --limit INTEGER              Max candidate rows
  --entity-id TEXT             Extract only for one entity ID
  --extractor [delimiter|llm]  Extraction strategy  [default: llm]
  --workers INTEGER            Texts extracted concurrently  [default: 1]
  --help                       Show this message and exit.
```

## `muckrake ner-review`

```text
Usage: muckrake ner-review [OPTIONS] [DATASET_NAME]

  Review pending NER extraction candidates.

Options:
  --limit INTEGER  Max pending candidates
  --auto           Approve every pending split without review; reject unsplit
                   extractions
  --help           Show this message and exit.
```

```

Options:

```

## `muckrake load`

```text
Usage: muckrake load [OPTIONS] [DATASET_NAME]

  Load statements into the database.

  DATASET_NAME should be the dataset name from config.yml (e.g., hello). If not
  provided, loads all datasets.

Options:
  --run-id INTEGER  Load statements from a specific dataset run
  --help            Show this message and exit.
```

## `muckrake export`

```text
Usage: muckrake export [OPTIONS]

  Export entities to FtM JSON.

Options:
  -o, --output PATH   Output file path  [required]
  -d, --dataset TEXT  Filter by dataset
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

## `muckrake add`

```text
Usage: muckrake add [OPTIONS]

  Add or update one FtM entity in the working database.

Options:
  --schema TEXT      FtM schema name  [required]
  --dataset TEXT     Dataset name used for provenance  [required]
  --source TEXT      Durable source reference  [required]
  --id TEXT          Explicit FtM entity ID
  --id-part TEXT     Stable key component used to generate an ID. Repeat as needed.
  --key-prefix TEXT  Optional FtM key prefix for generated IDs
  --property TEXT    Entity property in KEY=VALUE form. Repeat for more values.
                     [required]
  --pretty           Pretty-print JSON output
  --help             Show this message and exit.
```

## `muckrake update`

```text
Usage: muckrake update [OPTIONS] ENTITY_ID

  Update one FtM entity in the working database by ID.

Options:
  --schema TEXT    Optional replacement FtM schema name
  --dataset TEXT   Replacement dataset name used for rewritten provenance
  --source TEXT    Replacement source reference for rewritten provenance
  --property TEXT  Entity property in KEY=VALUE form. Repeat for more values.
                   [required]
  --pretty         Pretty-print JSON output
  --help           Show this message and exit.
```
